matching._fuzzy_comment: Order-preserving phonetic LCS matcher. Used as a FALLBACK only when exact shingle-hash confidence is below threshold (STT word errors break exact shingles). min_lcs_ratio = min (LCS length / query tokens) to accept a match; min_query_tokens guards against trusting very short queries; weight scales the fuzzy confidence; min_margin requires the top candidate to beat the runner-up by this gap (LCS is biased toward longer/common-word references, so ambiguous near-ties are rejected and the safer exact/acoustic verdict is kept).

_hybrid_comment: RECOMMENDED mode (identify_audio.py --hybrid). Stage 1 acoustically shortlists the top_candidates_count most likely episodes (high-recall, noise-tolerant); Stage 2 runs precise phonetic matching scoped ONLY to those candidates. Much faster than full-DB phonetic search and more accurate than acoustic alone. If acoustic finds nothing, phonetic falls back to the full database.
_dvd_comment: identify_dvd_episodes.py (batch DVD-rip identification) reuses the acoustic + matching + hybrid settings. 'acoustic_shortlist_reliable' is the minimum acoustic confidence for the shortlist to be trusted when scoping the phonetic fallback; below it, the phonetic fallback widens to the whole database so a wrong low-confidence acoustic top-1 cannot poison the result.
